title: Build in public: I built my own posting robot with AI

linkedin.media_title: I built my own posting robot with AI
linkedin.text:
People keep asking how I post three times a day while running companies.

I don't. A robot does. I built it with AI.

The problem was simple: I want to show up on LinkedIn and Instagram every day, and some days I simply can't.

The whole plan fit in one sentence: post my content at 8 AM, 1 PM and 7 PM, let me review it the night before, and let me cancel any post.

The building blocks were almost all free. GitHub stores the posts and runs them on a schedule. LinkedIn and Instagram's official tools publish them. Claude wrote and fixed the code with me. No developer team.

Then I shipped it, and real use found real problems. On day two, GitHub's timer started our posts hours late, so we added a backup trigger. That is normal. You only find those things by running it.

The bigger lesson: the blueprint for building has changed. What used to need a team, months and real money now takes one person, a few days and mostly free tools. The scarce skill is no longer writing code. It is knowing what to build, and steering the AI well.

Start with the task that annoys you every week.

What would you automate first?
